marta: Hey folks — quick heads up: Im planning a temporary move to my partner's place in Ireland for ~12 weeks starting May 6. I want to keep my official homebase as SF. A few Qs: 1) Am I still eligible for the WFH stipend/shipping for the duration? 2) Any startup/process I need to notify payroll/legal about re: tax nexus or local registration (Ill keep US hours and not take local employment). 3) My partner will be there too — does that affect benefits (spouse coverage) or payroll in any way? cc @elaine (People Ops)
elaine (People Ops): Thanks for flagging this, Marta — well help. Short answers up front: stipend/shipments likely OK for a short-term stay but we need to open a relocation/temporary-remote case to confirm. Spouse moving with you generally doesnt change your benefits eligibility, but it can affect local tax/residency in certain countries. Please DM me dates, full address, and whether youre taking company equipment with you.
raj (Payroll): FYI: 12 weeks is under the 183-day tax-residence threshold in most jurisdictions, so payroll withholding usually stays with the US. However: local rules vary (Ireland has specific registration requirements for stays over 90 days in some cases), and employer presence rules can be tricky. We need the exact dates and confirmation youre not doing local-sourced work for an Irish employer. I can run a quick payroll check once we have the dates.
jen (Legal): Please dont change your homebase in the HR system until we advise. Also fill out the short pre-travel questionnaire (link below) so our global mobility/legal team can check permanent establishment risk and local reporting. If youll have any in-person client meetings there, flag that too.
elaine (People Ops): Link to forms & policy: https://redwood.internal/people-ops/remote-travel (use the "temporary relocation" flow). Typical doc we need: travel dates, address, emergency contact, equipment list, and whether partner will be on visa or local docs. For stipend: we prorate if you cross a payroll boundary month; shipping covered if you request via relocation form. :white_check_mark:
relocation-bot: relocation-case #R-1284 opened for marta — workflow assigned to @elaine. Please upload address and dates within 48h.
marta: Thanks — DMing details now. Dates: 2025-05-06 to 2025-07-29, address in Cork, Ill bring my laptop and monitor. No client onsite meetings planned, keeping US working hours. Partner is an Irish resident but not on my benefits. Thanks everyone! :pray:
elaine (People Ops): Great — Ive started the case. Raj & Jen, looping you in on the case so we can confirm payroll/PE risk. Ill follow up with expected stipend proration and shipping label next steps by EOD tomorrow. If anything changes (longer stay or local work) please update immediately.
raj (Payroll): Got it — Ill run the payroll/residency check and post a note in the case. If we need to do any reporting, well coordinate before your departure.
jen (Legal): Adding a quick check for social security overlap and any required local notifications. Will confirm in the case thread by Monday.
marta: Amazing, appreciate the quick help. Will wait for the case updates. :smile:
